output: html_notebook

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nflfastR)
library(nflreadr)
```

```{r}
records <- read.csv("../../data/processed/team_records.csv")
```

```{r}
division_success <- records %>% 
  mutate(division_win_pct = div_wins / (div_wins + div_losses + div_ties)) %>% 
  # correcting it to a 0-1 scale
  mutate(division_win_percentile = percent_rank(division_win_pct),
         division_win_percentile = division_win_percentile/max(division_win_percentile)) %>% 
  select(season, team, coach, offense, defense, div_wins, div_losses, division_win_pct, division_win_percentile)
```

```{r}
write.csv(division_success, "../../data/processed/division_game_success.csv")
```

```{r}
fired <- c("TEN", "NYG", "ATL", "CLE", "LV", "BUF", "ARI", "BAL", "MIA")

division_success %>% 
  filter(season == 2025, team %in% fired) %>% 
  select(season, coach, team, div_wins, div_losses) %>% 
  group_by(coach) %>% 
  summarise(wins = sum(div_wins), losses = sum(div_losses), pct = wins/(wins+losses))
```
```{r}
superbowl_teams <- records %>% 
  filter(round_reached == "SB") %>% 
  mutate(div_win_pct = div_wins / (div_wins + div_losses)) %>% 
  # making the percentile season-based, to account for some more context
  group_by(season) %>% 
  mutate(div_win_percentile = percent_rank(div_win_pct)) %>% 
  select(season, team, coach, offense, defense, div_wins, div_losses, div_win_pct, div_win_percentile)

superbowl_teams %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  summarise(wins = sum(div_wins), losses = sum(div_losses), pct = wins/(wins+losses), teamsY = sum(div_win_pct >= .5), teamsN = sum(div_win_pct < .5))
```

```{r}
playoff_teams <- records %>% 
  filter(made_playoffs) %>% 
  mutate(div_win_pct = div_wins / (div_wins + div_losses)) %>% 
  # making the percentile season-based, to account for some more context
  group_by(season) %>% 
  mutate(div_win_percentile = percent_rank(div_win_pct)) %>% 
  select(season, team, coach, offense, defense, div_wins, div_losses, div_win_pct, div_win_percentile)

playoff_teams %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  summarise(wins = sum(div_wins), losses = sum(div_losses), pct = wins/(wins+losses), teamsY = sum(div_win_pct >= .5), teamsN = sum(div_win_pct < .5))
```

```{r}
coaches_2025 <- coaches %>% 
  filter(Year == 2025) %>% select(Coach) %>% pull()

division_success %>% 
  group_by(coach) %>% 
  filter(coach %in% coaches_2025) %>% 
  summarise(avg_score = sum(division_win_percentile) / n(), n = n()) %>% 
  arrange(desc(avg_score)) %>% 
  filter(n > 2)
```
